post.title: SideNotes wants $19.99. EdgeMark slides in free.
post.caption: Two fresh grudges: a paid notes panel on the edge of your screen, and two note-app bills for a tree of documents. Both rebuilt for free and open source.

segments.quote: But it's closed-source and paid, with no way to contribute, customize, or verify what it does with your data.
